title: "Hello, conflicts!"
---

```{r}
longest_substring <- function(s) {
  if (nchar(s) == 0) return(0)
  chars <- strsplit(s, "")[[1]]
  last_seen <- list() 
  start <- 1          
  max_len <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(chars)) {
    ch <- chars[i]
    if (!is.null(last_seen[[ch]]) && last_seen[[ch]] >= start) {
      start <- last_seen[[ch]] + 1 
    }
    last_seen[[ch]] <- i
    max_len <- max(max_len, i - start + 1)
  }
  max_len
}

print(longest_substring("polytopia"))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

heart_data <- data.frame(t = seq(0, 2 * pi, by = 0.01))
heart_data$x <- 16 * sin(heart_data$t)^3
heart_data$y <- 13 * cos(heart_data$t) - 5 * cos(2 * heart_data$t)-2 * cos(3 * heart_data$t) - cos(4 * heart_data$t)

ggplot(heart_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_polygon(fill = "pink", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void()
```
